help: Mention me to start a public channel conversation. Anyone here can continue until it times out. /chat-memory memories, /chat-memory forget, and /chat-memory reset manage the shared channel memory for everyone.
disabled: Chat is not enabled yet. The bot owner needs to configure Antigravity or Codex and set CHAT_ENABLED=true.
empty: There are no saved facts for this channel.
memoryFile: Shared memories for this channel are attached.
forgotten: Deleted the requested shared memories and cleared recent conversation for this channel.
reset: Recent conversation for this channel cleared. Shared memories are still available.
busy: I'm handling another chat request. Try again in a moment.
missing: That memory key does not exist. Use /chat-memory memories to see this channel's shared facts.
length: Please send a message between 1 and 4000 characters.
saved: Saved {{count}} memory update(s). View or delete them with /chat-memory memories and /chat-memory forget.
failed: I couldn’t complete that chat request. The bot owner can check provider sign-in, model access, and local chat storage.
settingsDenied: You need Manage Server permission to change this channel’s chat settings.
settingsFailed: Could not save chat settings. Use a gemini- or gpt- model ID. Gemini requires low, medium, or high reasoning and normal speed. For storage errors, contact the bot owner.
